page_title: NEW 4-3 WHU | Newcastle v West Ham 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
90+4' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) must have forgotten about the first yellow card that he received because he is shown a second one by the referee after his bad challenge!
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Danny Ings (West Ham) is coming onto the pitch as Vladimir Coufal cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+1' Yellow card. Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' 4 - 3 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
89' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) will replace James Ward-Prowse.
83' 3 - 3 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
82' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Lukasz Fabianski comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
80' David Moyes is stunned as referee Robert Jones shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
77' 2 - 3 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Lukasz Fabianski.
77' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
76' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Newcastle!
75' Referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Newcastle. Let’s see what happens!
75' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Newcastle for a penalty. Play continues.
73' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the left side of the goal, but Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
69' Substitution. Michail Antonio makes his way off the pitch and Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) comes on as his replacement.
67' Miguel Almiron is being substituted because of an injury. Eddie Howe sends Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) on the pitch.
66' Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
65' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
63' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
63' A pass by Kurt Zouma (West Ham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
62' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukasz Fabianski, who smothers the ball.
61' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
59' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
58' West Ham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' Emil Krafth comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
57' Eddie Howe decides to make a substitution. Joe Willock will be replaced by Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd).
56' Here comes a substitution. Valentino Livramento is given a rest as he is replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
55' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
54' West Ham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.
51' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
48' 1 - 3 Goal! Mohammed Kudus slips a clever pass through to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 1:3.
47' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Half-time substitution. Alphonse Areola is replaced by Lukasz Fabianski (West Ham).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+13' The end of the first half.
45+9' 1 - 2 Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the left post.
45+9' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+7' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
45+6' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the crossbar. Aim better, sir.
45+5' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
45+3' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
45' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
40' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
39' Newcastle quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

38' It looks like Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) saw red with that tackle. Robert Jones won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. West Ham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
36' Jacob Murphy picks out Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the six-yard box, but the headed attempt bends just round the right post.
34' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
32' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Michail Antonio (West Ham) is adjudged offside.
29' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
27' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' 1 - 1 Michail Antonio (West Ham) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
20' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
18' Wasted opportunity! Michail Antonio (West Ham) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
17' Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) is substituted due to injury. Eddie Howe gives a chance to Emil Krafth.
12' The game is interrupted now, Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' The ball falls kindly for Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
9' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alphonse Areola into the bottom left corner.
6' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
5' Referee Robert Jones is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Newcastle!
5' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Newcastle, he's going to review using VAR.
3' Referee Robert Jones sees the trip by Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Penalty awarded! Newcastle will take a penalty kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Newcastle will have the kick-off.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Today's referee will be Robert Jones.
